notes: Modified cash basis village; basis recorded as cash. Governmental funds (General, Street, Keno, LB840 Economic Development, LB840 Infrastructure) from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total column (pp4-5). Statement lists spending only by object, so governmental disbursements are split by fund column (p4, split_from): General and Keno → general government, Street → streets/highways, LB840 Economic Development → economic development, with review 'listed by object'; the functional split for the General Fund is in the departments schedule detail. Nonoperating sale of assets 13,389 and interest income 30,311 are printed below total expenditures: recorded as receipts with outside_printed_total. Transfers in 226,185 and out 226,185 (net zero in Total column). Cash = governmental fund balance the statement rolls forward (beginning 1,460,175, ending 1,754,489, p5); governmental cash on the balance sheet (p3) is 1,670,049 (101,400 + 117,859 + 19,862 + restricted 1,430,928), the rest being due from Water and Sewer 86,285 less taxes payable 1,845. Business-type = Water, Sewer, Sanitation proprietary funds (pp6-9): revenues, expenses and net position from p7; net position measure used. The proprietary funds are reported on the accrual basis, so the Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds (pp8-9, Total column) is recorded in proprietary (1,915,137 + 247,335 + 15,799 - 900,652 + 11,912 = 1,289,531). No printed single total for business-type, so operating plus nonoperating totals were added as computed. Interest and fees expense 24,948 is nonoperating, printed below total operating expenses, so flagged outside_printed_total. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1). Detail: General Fund departments combining statement (pp11-12) recorded by department column; the p10 all-funds budget schedule is used only for non-General funds (Streets, Keno, Water, Wastewater, Sanitation), and its all-funds revenue, planning/tree/animal/pool/park/library, debt service and transfer lines are not repeated (they overlap the General Fund schedule or mix funds); its Water, Wastewater and Sanitation actuals are on a budgetary basis (include capital outlay and debt) so differ from the proprietary statement. Total expenditures 3,369,110 on the budget schedule is not tied since only some lines are recorded. Sutherland budget schedule shows transfers in 612,816 vs 226,185 on the fund statement because it includes proprietary funds. Read pages 1-12 of 12.
